label: PF Backlog 170
title: Close-on-verify loop: auto-close backlog + intake when a run is verified (+ attach reports)
body: core/close_loop.py + config/verification-policy.json. Trigger: job_manager.finish (every run ends there). Scope-aware evidence (tests_passed, compliance_passed, no_blocking_defects, go_no_go, artifact_exists) from existing stores; build/entire require all; prototype/research/explore need artifact_exists. On verified: backlog implemented->closed + intake closed_verified() WITH report links attached (final-report, pipeline-execution-report, qa-manifest, quality-metrics, traceability.html, compliance-latest). On not-verified: backlog->blocked with reasons; intake stays open. force_close() audited override. API GET /api/verification + static verification.html. Verified E2E: prototype item -> verified -> backlog+intake closed with report links; test data cleaned. compileall=0, wired_audit=0.

dashboard_impact.reason: Verification status + report links surface in the dashboard (intake/backlog views).
